responsibility: Implements the generic-substitution data model carried by substitution-aware TyTy types. It defines substitution parameter mappings, concrete substitution arguments, and substitution-argument sets; validates bound compatibility when filling parameters; computes mappings from generic arguments, inherited receiver substitutions, and partially instantiated types; and performs higher-ranked bound and associated-type setup during monomorphization of generic items and trait predicates.
same_name_distinction: Implements the substitution machinery defined by this stem, including parameter filling, argument mapping behavior, associated-impl lookup, ambiguity handling, and monomorphization-time higher-ranked bound setup; the header mainly defines the substitution framework's types and APIs.
